name: day1-tornado-corridor-experiment-v2
changes_from_v1: arms b and c use the same smooth monotone calibration (beta calibration) instead of isotonic; arm a keeps the v0.7 recipe's Platt step
unchanged_from_v1: wider-feature definition, radii, statistics, edge handling and transform (v1 rules.wider_features)
6 month-grouped outer folds (phase2_study.fold_of) and inner month folds
all five pass criteria and their definitions (v1 rules.pass_criteria_c_vs_b)
2024 diagnostic only; 2021 once only on a full pass; 2025 sealed
roster: research/severe/corridor/v2/roster.json (362 dates: 96 original + March-July 2022 and 2023; fold sizes 70/16/70/68/70/68 dates; fold 1 holds only Feb/Aug months)

calibration.arm_a: Platt (monotone logistic on the inner out-of-fold logit), as the v0.7 recipe
calibration.arms_b_c: beta calibration: logistic regression of the outcome on [ln p, -ln(1-p)] where p = expit(inner out-of-fold logit), both slopes constrained >= 0 (monotone non-decreasing), intercept free, penalty 1e-4; fitted inside each training fold on that fold's inner out-of-fold predictions only
calibration.why: smooth and monotone with 3 parameters, so it cannot form the isotonic top step (v1 forecast 89% vs observed 20%)

reporting_added: matched-area results before calibration (uncalibrated logistic scores) and after calibration, for arms b and c
the original 96-date subset of the held-out predictions alongside the full 362-date sample (not deciding)
number of distinct event dates (and report points) supporting each reliability bin, especially >= 30%
pass_criteria: identical to v1 rules.pass_criteria_c_vs_b, evaluated on the full 362-date held-out sample

maps.fills_gap: held-out day with the largest (arm b left-out - arm c left-out) among days where arm c has more hits than arm b at matched area
maps.spreads_along_front: held-out day with the largest increase in matched-area false-alarm area (c - b) among days where arm c has no more hits than arm b
maps.note: each map is drawn only if such a day exists

if_pass: freeze arm c fitted on all 362 dates (hash committed) and verify once on the sealed 2021 list (96 dates)
if_fail: post the exact misses to PR #31 and stop for review; 2021 stays sealed
unchanged: live v0.7 map, RRFS/NBM collector, 2025 sealed
